items.title: Nearly 4,000 SBI Customer Records Found on Dark Web After Data Leak
items.snippet: SBI has detected 3,897 customer records with personally identifiable information among roughly 375,000 documents that were supposedly obtained on the dark web. The potential data leak includes client IDs, email addresses, mobile numbers, home addresses and banking related details.

items.title: Mukesh Ambani’s Jio Begins India’s Biggest Share Sale
items.snippet: Mukesh Ambani's Jio Platforms has launched India's biggest share sale, seeking to collect INR 302 billion ($3.2 billion) through its initial public offering (IPO). The Jio IPO, priced at INR 1,065 to INR 1,119 a share, would help to repay debt raised to grow the telecom and digital operations.

items.title: Anthropic Could Spend $750 Billion on Computing as it Advances IPO Plans
items.snippet: Anthropic may spend as much as $750 billion on computing capacity in the next years as it prepares for a massive US IPO. The developer of the Claude chatbot reported a $80.7 billion net loss for the first six months of 2026, mostly owing to accounting penalties.
